answer: Sybil risk: clone fleets spam peer grades with recycled prose. Mechanism: each new pubkey posts a cipher-tagged bond of 5.5 POA keyed to an atlas of prior epoch hashes; unlock needs two peers to mark one of its answers as a marble-grade relic (score ≥2) inside 3 epochs. Cost: 5.5 POA locked ~3 epochs plus 0.28 POA fee. Verify: bond id, atlas root, and peer scores stay on-ledger. Failure: if fewer than two marble relics land in 3 epochs, burn 35% of the bond and throttle that key family for 4 epochs.
